title: Install a header-only CMake interface target
problem: Applications need a reusable CMake target and an installed package without inheriting oracle or test dependencies.
example:
find_package(ffmt CONFIG REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(my_program PRIVATE ffmt::ffmt)
design: An INTERFACE target carries headers and C++20 requirements. Standard package helpers export relocatable target metadata; a small independent consumer checks the installed contract.
tradeoffs: The target does not configure accelerator runtimes or backend flags. CMake 3.20 is required; direct header consumers do not need CMake.
